reviewed_by: Claude general-purpose subagent, blind judgment reviewer, wide-packet re-review batch 1, 2026-08-01

samples_reviewed.question_text: What number comes next when counting: 18, 19, 20, 21, ___?
The number 20 is written in words as 'twenty'. True or False?
Arrange these numbers from largest to smallest: 22, 24, 25, 23

competency_fulfillment.rationale: The competency names number line, block/bar model, and numeral representations, but of the eight widened samples only seed 50's 'What number is marked?' visibly uses a model; the rest are word-conversion ('Write 33 in words.'), count-sequence, or ordering text with no block/bar representation at all.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Block or bar models, one of the three representations the competency explicitly names alongside number line and numerals, never appears across any of the eight seeds, including the two extra seeds (51, 110) added specifically to catch alternate formatter paths.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Prompts like seed 45's 'What number comes next when counting: 18, 19, 20, 21, ___?' and seed 110's 'Arrange these numbers from largest to smallest: 22, 24, 25, 23' are short, single-instruction sentences fitting Grade 1 Quarter 1.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Beyond the single number-line item at seed 50, the remaining seven samples split between numeral-to-word conversion and count-sequence/ordering tasks, so the 'variety of concrete and pictorial models' the competency calls for is represented by exactly one sample out of eight.

competency_alignment.rationale: Seed 110's 'Arrange these numbers from largest to smallest: 22, 24, 25, 23' tests numeric ordering, a distinct skill from 'recognize and represent numbers using models', showing the sampled variation drifting into an unrelated ordering axis rather than building this node's representation competency.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Numeral values across all eight seeds range only from 14 to 29 (seed 50's marked value), never approaching the competency's stated up-to-100 ceiling.
